title: nf-cmgg/report pipeline - params.seqcap_exomecnv.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.seqcap_exomecnv.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

design.errorMessage: SeqCap design name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

panel.errorMessage: Screening panel name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

design_genelist.description: Text file with one gene symbol per line for the full SeqCap design.

panel_genelist.description: Text file with one gene symbol per line for the screening panel.

vcf.description: VEP-annotated ExomeDepth CNV calls (VCF) for the sample.

cnv_database.description: Tab-separated historical CMGG CNV database file for the full SeqCap design.
